en: Isn't it hard on you?
...I don't want to hear words like that...
Night
You're often active at night. Doesn't that cause you trouble?
...I've never even thought about it.{wait}{clear}Besides, I live in the world of darkness so I can bury as many of them as possible...
Sometimes I find the darkness of night frightening...
.........Even an angel feels that? No, maybe it's because you're an angel...?{wait}{clear}I suppose it means you and I live in different worlds...
Someday, I'm sure peaceful nights will come to you too, Clive...
...Someday... If that day really, truly comes someday...{wait}{clear}Can we drop this subject?
Is there anything else you want to discuss?
If this tired me out, I couldn't keep up with you, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}I'm totally fine, so let's hurry on.
Wanting to walk, that's a rare one. Floating around looks easier, doesn't it?
It really does...{wait}{clear}The wind after a sudden rain carries the smell of the trees and grass...{wait}{clear}We can't let a world like that be destroyed...
Even so, if you only walk easy roads, you'll never get where you're going.{wait}{clear}Though if a road's too dangerous, sometimes you've got to steer clear of it.
Well... I'd be lying if I said I never get lost.{wait}{clear}Towns and villages are fine, but in forests it's hard to find landmarks, so I'd get lost...

I love the sky too. Like the clear blue sky on a hot day...{wait}{clear}Looking at the sky makes my worries seem silly. Like it's telling me not to fret over such tiny things...{wait}{clear}But I envy you, ＄＄＄＄＄＄. You can fly in that sky.
Yeah... I've got to protect the views of Legrance I love, too.{wait}{clear}The sea lit by the sunset, the wilds with nothing but twinkling stars... I've got to...
Yeah, they're a big help. Just don't work them too hard, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.
Sure. You have lots of time to think when you travel.{wait}{clear}And I feel like I understand all sorts of things. More than when I was in Legrance.
Yeah, meeting all kinds of people is nice.{wait}{clear}I feel like lots of important things are scattered through idle chatter in places like taverns.
Yeah... I hope the night comes soon when I can always feel that way...{wait}{clear}I need to try harder... I've got to...
Yeah, thanks. Aren't you tired, ＄＄＄＄＄＄? You should get some rest soon.

You ask weird stuff, as always. Well, fine.{wait}{clear}I like sleeping. Napping in the cool shade of a tree on a hot day, or by a window, feels great.{wait}{clear}Though I don't think I can afford to laze around like that right now.
Yeah, thanks. I'll take you up on that and get some rest.
Let's see... Nothing special... I do care for my sword in case something happens.{wait}{clear}These days, you never know what might happen.
Let's see... I guess I've gotten pretty used to it. I can't always go home, and anyway, I couldn't if I wanted to...{wait}{clear}This journey has toughened me up a lot, in a good way.
When I can't sleep? Let's see...{wait}{clear}I roll around in bed, or go outside to clear my head...{wait}{clear}Trying too hard to sleep keeps you up, so I just zone out.

Yeah... Maybe it's more accurate to say I always think about it.{wait}{clear}Traveling with ＄＄＄＄＄＄ like this, I got the chance to see Legrance from other countries, and I think I've started to see things I couldn't before.{wait}{clear}I feel like I understand my brother better, too...
Sure, I don't mind. Is there something you want to talk about?
Something I always do, like washing my face? You ask weird things, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.
Yeah, I've barely started. There's no point if I don't keep at it...{wait}{clear}Besides, I like moving my body. I feel calmer when I'm active.
Cut it out. I'm not fighting just for you, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}I'm only doing what's natural, so don't thank me.
What are you saying? Of course training is hard.{wait}{clear}Besides, the hardship of training is no big deal at all.{wait}{clear}It's a step toward getting stronger.
This much is nothing. I don't need a break yet. You don't have to worry so much, so just leave me be.
Yeah, thanks. So that's how it looks... It's kinda embarrassing, but I'm glad.{wait}{clear}It may not seem like me, but I really like training.
Sure I am. I'm always toughening myself up like this, and traveling with you has toughened me up too, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.
Yeah, I'll be careful. If I got hurt training, I'd be in no shape to fight.{wait}{clear}I won't do anything reckless.
What I watch most is my focus. If I can't focus, it feels like none of the training sinks in.
Yeah, it's going great.{wait}{clear}I feel ready for whenever a request comes from you, ＄＄＄＄＄＄. So don't worry.

Yeah, that's what makes me happiest. But fighting and hurting people feels like a different thing...{wait}{clear}I never thought about it much before I set out, but I think you must never misuse your strength...
Not at all. Geez, you worry about me too much.{wait}{clear}I think you can stand your ground more and be a bit pushier.{wait}{clear}Well, maybe that's impossible for you, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.
Hahaha...! Asking stuff like that is so like you, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}What I like is napping and playing. Either I'm moving around or I'm asleep. Simple, I know.
Well, I think so. You'll forgive me for taking it easy between fights now and then, right...?

An abrupt question, just like you, ＄＄＄＄＄＄. Well, that's nothing new...{wait}{clear}When I was little... back when I didn't know anything, I played with my brother... and Mom was there too... It's a good memory from long ago now.
Sure. You must be tired too, ＄＄＄＄＄＄, so you should rest a bit.
Yeah... I know... But if I'm worn out, I can't give it my all. It's fine to rest a little, right?
Thanks. You should rest too, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.
Yeah, I guess. So much has happened that it's hard to sort it all out in my head.{wait}{clear}But I think I have to think it through. There's still time...

Well, once I left Fanlan I could act fairly freely, so I've been to crowded places.{wait}{clear}But inside Legrance, you never knew what might happen, so I was always on edge...{wait}{clear}Even now, anything could happen, but not being bound by rank or family makes it so much easier.{wait}{clear}So if you ask me, ＄＄＄＄＄＄, I'll go to crowded places.
Yeah, I'm eating fine. There's food you can't get in Legrance, so I really look forward to meals.{wait}{clear}Though some things only grow in Legrance, so sometimes something's missing.
Don't worry so much. I'm fine.
Yeah, I'm fine. I'll beat the enemy, you'll see.
Yeah... First, let's see how the enemy comes at us...
Yeah, I won't let my guard down. No matter the enemy.
No, there's no point worrying now that we're here. All that's left is to size up the enemy in battle.
Yeah, thanks. I'll beat the enemy, you'll see.
I appreciate the worry, but when you're like that, it makes ME worried.
I'm sure you'll be fine, Rudi.
Yeah... Thanks for saying so. But I don't plan on letting my guard down, so leave it to me.
Don't say it with such a miserable face... It's a bad omen.
I get how you feel, but calm down. You're making me nervous too.
This is... because I wasn't strong enough... Don't worry about it, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.
Come on, don't make such a fuss. It's embarrassing...
Don't thank me. Losing doesn't exactly look cool...
No, don't worry about it... It's because I wasn't strong enough.
No, I'm fine, so don't worry.
It's not your fault, ＄＄＄＄＄＄. If only I were stronger...{wait}{clear}So please don't apologize.
No, I don't mind being relied on... I'm just ashamed I couldn't live up to it.{wait}{clear}But I'll make this a good lesson and get stronger.
No... I just couldn't size up the enemy. It really drove home how weak I am...{wait}{clear}I need to hone my skills more, much more... more...
